bundle.shortDescription: AI trading assistant for perpetual futures
bundle.longDescription: Octo Gens is a desktop AI assistant for trading perpetual futures with your own web3 wallet. Connect a model from OpenRouter, Cloudflare AI Gateway, Ollama or LM Studio. It researches with live market data, sizes positions from the risk you accept, and drafts orders that you confirm. Practice on testnet with test funds.
